criteria.text: Judge in `python -m web`: opens 'Klasy dokumentów', creates a new class (e.g. 'wezwanie' with two fields) from the built-in template, sees a validation error with file/JSON path for a broken regex, fixes it, tests it on an uploaded PDF (classification score, extracted fields with evidence), saves it; the next upload and `python -m odw2json` on ./input use the new class without restart; editing and deleting a class work; the screen follows Cold Trace in night and daylight and at 375px.
